Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition EHDSSpecimen

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
EHDSSpecimen 0..*BaseSpecimen model
EHDSSpecimen.identifier 1..*IdentifierAn identifier of the specimen which is unique within a defined scope.
EHDSSpecimen.status 0..1CodeableConceptAvailability of the specimen.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: HL7 Specimen Status
EHDSSpecimen.type 0..1CodeableConceptThe kind of material that forms the specimen.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS
EHDSSpecimen.specimenSource[x] 0..1The source where the specimen came from. This may be from a patient, from a location (e.g. the source of an environmental sample) or from a device.
EHDSSpecimen.specimenSource[x].specimenSourceEHDSPatientEHDSPatient
EHDSSpecimen.specimenSource[x].specimenSourceEHDSLocationEHDSLocation
EHDSSpecimen.specimenSource[x].specimenSourceEHDSDeviceEHDSDevice
EHDSSpecimen.parentSpecimen 0..*EHDSSpecimenSpecimen from which this specimen originated.
EHDSSpecimen.request 0..*EHDSServiceRequestService request on the basis of which the specimen was collected.
EHDSSpecimen.collection 0..*BaseCollection details.
EHDSSpecimen.collection.performer[x] 0..1Person or organisation who collected the specimen.
EHDSSpecimen.collection.performer[x].performerEHDSHealthProfessionalEHDSHealthProfessional
EHDSSpecimen.collection.performer[x].performerEHDSOrganisationEHDSOrganisation
EHDSSpecimen.collection.performer[x].performerEHDSPatientEHDSPatient
EHDSSpecimen.collection.performer[x].performerEHDSRelatedPersonEHDSRelatedPerson
EHDSSpecimen.collection.collected[x] 1..1The period or date and time of specimen collection.
EHDSSpecimen.collection.collected[x].collectedPeriodPeriod
EHDSSpecimen.collection.collected[x].collectedDateTimedateTime
EHDSSpecimen.collection.quantity 0..1QuantityThe quantity of specimen collected.
EHDSSpecimen.collection.method 0..1CodeableConceptIf relevant for the results, the method of obtaining the specimen.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS
EHDSSpecimen.collection.device 0..1EHDSDeviceDevice used to perform specimen collection.
EHDSSpecimen.collection.bodySite 0..1EHDSBodyStructureAnatomic location where the material is collected.
EHDSSpecimen.receivedDate 0..1dateTimeDate and time when specimen is received by the testing laboratory.
EHDSSpecimen.container 0..*BaseThe container holding the specimen.
EHDSSpecimen.container.specimenQuantity 0..1QuantityQuantity of specimen within the container.
EHDSSpecimen.container.containerDevice 1..1EHDSDeviceThe device for the container holding the specimen.
EHDSSpecimen.condition 0..*CodeableConceptState of the specimen. State of the specimen shall be aligned with the dataAbsentReason element of the Observation model.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: HL7 Specimen Condition
EHDSSpecimen.note 0..1stringAny details or issues about the specimen or during the specimen collection (for example: broken vial, sent with patient, frozen).
